name: Abraham
role: Biblical patriarch and father of the covenant
dateNote: Section 84 says he received the priesthood from Melchizedek.
importance: Section 84 places him in the priesthood line and says the faithful become “the seed of Abraham”. In section 110 Elias commits “the gospel of Abraham”. Section 132 says Abraham received wives and concubines by command and was not condemned, and it tells Joseph Smith to “do the works of Abraham”. Sections 137 and 138 report seeing him among the saved.
connections: The D&C names Melchizedek, Isaac, Jacob, Sarah, and Hagar with him. Section 124 says Joseph Smith Sr. “sitteth with Abraham”.
reviewNote: Described only as the D&C presents him. He is also named in 27, 98, 101, 103, 109, 110, 124, and 136. Section 132 statements are reported as the revelation’s words.
